subject: 上海市徐汇区宛平路42号住宅，5D055
local_frame: Street line runs south to north. The perpendicular inward side points west-southwest. Images use pixel origin at top left. Front projections use an ENU tangent frame around basis_wgs84.

model_dimensions.method: A ray from the image centre is rotated according to the archived rectilinear camera field of view and orientation, then intersected with the vertical plane of the end wall. Both end positions are differenced against a front-corner observation in the same image. These depth differences are insensitive to most image-heading and datum offset.
model_dimensions.roof: Across four imagery releases the strip immediately behind the front is pale grey or dark grey. The offset of its first transverse roof boundary relative to ground varies in the imagery by about two metres. The higher street block is independently stopped at the observed end-wall back edges. Its shallow roof uses the south and north end outlines. Internal drainage, intervening terrace fittings and the far face are unresolved. The distinct red-tiled western courtyard building has its own visible ridge and lower eave and is outside this model.
model_dimensions.north_end: The high north wall is largely warm, plain render. The rear break in its high coping is directly visible from the north. Lower attached structures have a different eave. Only small unresolved attachments occur in these views.
model_dimensions.south_end: Three windows near the street edge stack in the same upper three storeys. Two shorter slots occur near the rear edge in the upper part. Their centerlines and corner pairs are independently measured. Paint, sashes and AC fittings vary over time.
model_dimensions.scope: This is a reconstruction of the public exterior of the high street block. The rear closure has a neutral finish and no inferred apertures.

limitations: Coordinates are from provider-derived surface positions, not a cadastral boundary. In the upper storeys the independent camera-height solutions differ by up to 1.5 m. Window heights in the mesh therefore share the existing front-wall level datum. Façade horizontal scale and the datum are documented separately in model-to-street-control.json.
